_comment: Governed-AI wiring for M7 (ADR-0020). Two MCP servers: 'datahub' for catalog/governance discovery (what exists, owner, PII class, lineage) and 'semantic' for the governed metric number (compiled from the same Apache Ossie specs Superset uses). Replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/REPO and the warehouse password/port. Local DataHub needs no token. For prod see the _comment in the datahub env. See ai/README.md.

env._comment: Local dev: no token -- GMS runs with METADATA_SERVICE_AUTH_ENABLED=false and serves tokenless calls as the system user. Prod: rename _PROD_DATAHUB_GMS_TOKEN to DATAHUB_GMS_TOKEN and set a service-account PAT (docs/production-readiness.md).
